functions.purpose: GUI/Flash model init for the gift-pack subsystem. Binds named RPC/callback slots via FUN_104d13b0 so the client model can query/request gift data. Guarded by in_stack_00000014==1 (one-time init flag).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only. Enumerates the gift command surface the server must implement/authorize: GetConsectiveLoginGiftItemList->108fdb10, GetOnlineTimeGiftItemList->108fdf30, GetNewerUpgradeGiftItemList->108fe3b0, ReqGetGift->108fe7d0, GetCanFetchedGiftPackNum->108fd970, GetGroupInfoData->108fc8b0, GetGiftPackData->108fccc0, GetOnlineGiftTimeData->108fd700.
formulas: callback bit-flag check: (flags>>6 & 1) tests smart-ref ownership before invoking release vtbl+8 (stock ref-counted string/handle idiom, repeated throughout chunk)
functions.notes: 'Consective' is the game's own misspelling of Consecutive (consecutive-login reward). ReqGetGift is the actual claim command.

functions.purpose: Builds the client display VO array 'giftListArray' for the gift-pack panel from server-pushed/config data. Iterates gift entries (FUN_108fc5a0 count, FUN_108fc510 by index), matches CONSECTIVE_LOGIN/ONLINE_TIME/NEWER_UPGRADE/WEAPON item classnames, and emits per-entry fields.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display builder; the currency/state values it emits (boundGold, unboundGold, state, totalTime) are read from server-authoritative structures. Server owns the real gift state and grant.
formulas: nOnlineTime = ((*(int*)(giftObj+0x3c) - *(int*)(giftObj+0x40)) + _time64(0)) * 1000  (converts server epoch-delta seconds to ms)
boundGold = FUN_117faa00() ; unboundGold = FUN_117fac50()  (current player wallet snapshot)
state = giftEntry+0xc field, or 0 if lookup (vtbl+0x20)(entryId) == 0
if gift type (iVar3+0x2c) == 2: totalTime = FUN_117fac90() * 1000 (online-time gift)
if gift type == 1: consecutive-login gift, builds subItemList from SUB_ITEM_CLASSNAME entries (itemID via vtbl+0x18, itemCnt=entry+8, itemIconPathName=itemDef+0xb4)
sentinel/uninitialized marker = -0x21524151 (0xDEADBEAF) when a TLV field tag &0x8f is not 3 (int) or 4
costs: boundGold/unboundGold = dual-currency wallet (bound vs tradable gold)
functions.notes: Heavy decompiler stack-var aliasing; TLV field-tag test (byte & 0x8f) == 3/4/6/9/10 recurs throughout (3/4=int, 6=ref/string, 9=array, 10=object).

functions.purpose: Builds 'newPlayerGiftList' VO for the newbie/upgrade gift panel. Iterates gift entries filtering type (iVar2+0x2c)==3 (NEWER_UPGRADE), emits per-entry item rows and wallet/state.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display builder; emitted boundGold/unboundGold/state are server-authoritative snapshots.
formulas: per reward item: itemID = (itemDef vtbl+0x18)(), itemCnt = entry+8, itemIconPathName = itemDef+0xb4

functions.purpose: GUI model init for PVP room/agreement panel. Registers PVP query callbacks and pushes a few enforce-time/rate config scalars to the Flash model.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only. Not a currency path. enforceSpecialTime and rateX/Y begin/end are UI layout/rate config scalars fetched from FUN_117424xx accessors.
formulas: rateXBegin=FUN_117424a0(), rateXEnd=FUN_117424b0(), rateYBegin=FUN_117424c0(), rateYEnd=FUN_117424d0() (each preceded by FUN_117423e0 selector)
functions.notes: Included only because it sits in the economy chunk; primarily PVP UI plumbing.

functions.purpose: GUI model init for the leaderboard/ranking + rapid-hunt reward panel. Binds rank data and reward-fetch callbacks.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only. Command surface: GetRankTitleList->1090bfa0, ReqRankDataList->1090c460, UpdateRankDataList->1090cd20, FetchReward->1090d680 (server must authorize reward grant), UpdateRapidHuntDataList->1090c690, UpdateRapidHuntAwardData->1090d730, FetchHuntRapidHuntReward->1090db70 (claim).

functions.purpose: Builds RANK_BASE_DATA_VO array 'arrDataList' for the leaderboard from server-pushed rank rows. Emits rank, name, guild/clan, two data columns with type/unit, reward item id/name/fetched flag, level name, and viewer's own position.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display builder. Reward eligibility (bRewardFetched) and reward item id are server-authoritative; client only renders.
formulas: row stride = 0xa0 bytes; entry count = ((int)piStack_164 - iStack_168) / 0xa0
record header stride from ppiStack_120 blocks = >>5 (0x20)
column meta from FUN_1090b6c0(rankType): nColumn1Type=+0x14, nColumn2Type=+0x18, nColumn1Unit=+0x1c, nColumn2Unit=+0x20
reward emitted only if row index (unaff_EDI) < uStack_180 (reward-count cap); else nRewardItemID=0
functions.notes: 'nMyPostion' is the game's spelling. Uses FUN_100ecfd0/FUN_100ed090 UTF conversion for name strings.

functions.purpose: GUI model init that registers a large table of callbacks for the character build-up / skill-unlock / league-registration panel via repeated FUN_100b62c0 (bind name) + FUN_1091d8d0 (register slot) pairs.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only. Server-relevant command surface: GetBuildUpData, LevelUpBuild (server must validate cost & apply level), GetFundData, GetUnlockData, GetCandidateSkillData, GetSkillViewData, GetLeagueRegistrationViewData, UnlockItem (server validates unlock cost), LearnSkill (server validates & grants skill), ReqLeagueRegistration, GiveUpLeagueRegistration, sendGuildMatchSignUpList.
functions.notes: LevelUpBuild/UnlockItem/LearnSkill are the authoritative mutation commands; their handlers (FUN_1091a730..FUN_1091cec0) are elsewhere. This function only wires names to handler addresses.

functions.purpose: Static-config accessor: returns element[param_1] from the CPlayerVIPLevelUpInfo singleton's contiguous array (the VIP level-up requirement/reward table). Lazy-inits the info manager via CInfoManager::FindByName.
functions.serverRelevance: config lookup used by both sides; server should treat this table as authoritative source of VIP level-up thresholds.
formulas: return valid iff 0 <= param_1 < count, value = *(base[5] + param_1*4), else 0

functions.purpose: Resolves the CPlayerVIPLevelUpInfo singleton (lazy-init) and invokes its vtbl+0x28 method (ref release / RAII teardown helper).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only plumbing.

functions.purpose: GUI model init for the cash-shop / mart panel. Registers the full mart command table (bind-name FUN_100b62c0 + register FUN_10935d40 pairs) and wires several C2AS/AS2C net notify handlers via FUN_10d17440/FUN_10d17870. Clears mart model state fields at the end.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only registration, but the most economy-critical command surface in the chunk. Server must be authoritative over: RequestBuy (FUN_10930720), GetCurPrice (FUN_10930a60), RequestOpenVip (FUN_1092fbb0), FetchOpenVipData/FetchExtendVipData, RapidBuyVip (FUN_10931830), RequestWorldPay_Face/RequestWorldPay_Sex (paid appearance/gender change), C2AS_GetMartItemData, C2AS_OpenWeiXinWindow (WeChat recharge), AS2C_RequestRefreshNum, OpenMartVipPanelNotify. GoodsListReq/GetMartData/GetSelItemGroupData/GetCharCreditData/GetPurchaseItemData are read queries.
costs: RequestBuy is the authoritative purchase command; RapidBuyVip/RequestOpenVip are VIP purchase commands; WorldPay_Face/Sex are premium currency sinks (paid character customization).
functions.notes: Enormous stack-relay decompilation is the standard bind/register idiom repeated ~50x; only the name->handler mapping matters. Server-side price computation lives in the RequestBuy/GetCurPrice handlers, not here.

functions.purpose: Builds the achievement/'spoor' (footprint/track) task event VO list for the client panel. Iterates event definitions (FUN_10947810 count, FUN_10947780 by index) and emits per-event display fields plus completion timestamp breakdown.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display builder; progress (eventCurrent/eventFinish), reward value and completion time come from server-authoritative event state.
formulas: spoorGroupID: when def[6]==2, scan group table (base+0x2d10) matching index==def[7] -> value at +4
finish date: local_58 = completion epoch, _localtime64 -> finishDay=tm_mday, finishYear=tm_year, finishMonth=tm_mon
newClear/newDetailClear flag uVar1 set if event id present in global cleared-set [DAT_123bd2a8..DAT_123bd2ac)
functions.notes: CPet__SetName calls here are misattributed by the decompiler to a shared std::string assign thunk, not actual pet naming.

functions.purpose: Builds the spoor/achievement reward-claim list (FUN_10923e00 count, FUN_10923d70 by index). Emits ItemID, fetched/claimable flags, contribution value, reward index, prize id, and the player's current spoor points.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display; isFetch/canFetch and currentSpoorValue are server-authoritative (FUN_11504c20 claimable, FUN_11504d90 fetched-state, FUN_11504d20 current points).
formulas: contributeValue = rewardEntry[8]  (spoor points threshold for this reward)
costs: contributeValue = accumulated contribution/spoor points required to unlock each reward tier

functions.purpose: Builds 'rewardItemArray' preview (itemID/itemName/itemCounts) for a spoor prize pack and computes the two-currency purchase price of the pack for display, applying a rank-based discount multiplier.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only PRICE DISPLAY. Server must independently compute/validate the true bound & unbound price; client discount rates come from CPlayer hunt-rank accessors and must not be trusted.
formulas: base price record = FUN_109478c0(packId); baseBoundPrice = record+0x18, baseUnboundPrice = record+0x1c
discount multipliers: if FUN_10947a30(mailId)==0 -> fStack_98 = fStack_9c = DAT_11de9918 (default rate, likely 1.0f)
else fStack_98 (bound-rate) = FUN_11860ff0(huntRank), fStack_9c (unbound-rate) = FUN_11861030(huntRank)  (per-hunt-rank price scalars)
reward preview loop stride 0x14 over prize groups (FUN_1052c520/FUN_1052c6a0), inner item stride 9 dwords; itemID=*puVar6, itemCounts=puVar6[2]
costs: dual-currency pack price: bound gold price (record+0x18) and unbound/tradable gold price (record+0x1c), each scaled by a hunt-rank discount factor
functions.notes: This is the clearest cost formula in the chunk: server-side must reproduce base*rate with the correct hunt-rank rate table and NOT accept client-sent totals.

functions.purpose: Static-config accessor into the CLeagueRewardInfo 2D reward table (rank-tier -> reward). Lazy-inits the info manager. Returns the reward id for a linear rank index.
functions.serverRelevance: config lookup for both sides; server-authoritative league reward table.
formulas: valid iff idx>=0 and idx < base+0x24 (total count) and base+0x28 (cols/stride) != 0
special: param_1==-1 rejected; param_1==0 only valid when base+0x30 (offset)==0

reward: if uStack_1fc(no-reward flag)==0 and FUN_1094ed10 returns >0 -> nRewardItemID=1, bRewardFetched=0; else nRewardItemID=0, bRewardFetched=1

functions.purpose: Builds the weapon 'wake'/awaken (enchant-upgrade) panel data for the currently selected weapon: current/max level & layer, next-level money cost & success probability, wake-times usage, VIP gate, and current/next attribute names/descriptions.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display of server-config awaken costs/probabilities. Server MUST authoritatively charge nNextMoney / nWakeCostMoney, roll nNextProbability, enforce nMaxWakeTimes and nVipNeedLevel on the actual awaken command.
formulas: weapon record via FUN_113f9bb0; weaponLevel = record[0x6b], nPreNextMoney = piStack_6c = weapon current-tier field(+0x18)
bIsVip = (player charm/level FUN_1025b060() >= nVipNeedLevel) when weapon+11000 set and FUN_11549b10(10) true
nWakeAttr: if current awaken attr (FUN_116c4f30 at level iStack_98)==0 -> 0xffffffff, else attr = attrDef+0xb4; strNextName/strNextDesc from next tier (FUN_116c4f30 at +1)
costs: nNextMoney: gold cost of next awaken attempt
nWakeCostMoney: gold cost per wake-times consumption tier (record+0x7c)
nNextProbability: success probability of next awaken
nVipNeedLevel: VIP level gate for the operation
functions.notes: 'Wake'/'awaken' = the weapon strengthen/enchant-upgrade system (CVipCutOffInfo threshold table + FUN_11744xxx cost/probability lookups). Highest-value economy formulas in chunk after 10948d90.

functions.purpose: Builds the wake-point / awaken-progress sub-panel: max & current wake points, current/max wake times, per-attempt money cost, and a two-value 'collumn' pair.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display; server owns wake-point balance, wake-times, and cost.
formulas: collumn + &DAT_11dbfe78 pair filled from FUN_11669710() decomposed 64-bit result
costs: nWakeCostMoney: gold per wake attempt indexed by current wake-times-1; nMaxWakePoint: point cap

functions.purpose: GUI model init for the charm-found (charm forging/appraisal) + item-decompose panel. Binds the charm/decompose command callbacks. Guarded by init flag (in_stack_00000014==1).

Server-authoritative commands: GetCharmFoundData, ReqCharmFound (charm forge attempt - server charges cost & rolls result), CheckCharmFound, RefreshMoneyData, ReqItemDecompose (server removes items & grants decompose yield), GetItemDecomposeResultData->10959760, CheckBindStateAfterCharmFound.

functions.purpose: Builds the item-decompose preview/result VO. Emits three source lists (itemBagList, itemStoreList, itemMailList) of DECOMPOSE_ITEM_VO entries and a bIsBonus flag. Reads candidate items from bag (base+0), store (base+0x64), and mail (playerObj+0x70) containers.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display builder; the actual item removal and reward grant happen server-side on ReqItemDecompose. Server must validate quantities, bind-type and rarity.
formulas: each list built by walking a container array (count = (-basePtr>>2) or (end-begin)>>2, stride 4 = item pointers)
per item: itemID = *puVar1 (=&DAT_11dbb0b4 key), count = puVar1[1], m_nBindType = puVar1[2]
asset (icon) = itemDef+0xb4 for bag; store: itemDef+0xb4; mail: iVar6+0xb4
costs: m_nBindType (bound/unbound) and m_nRareType (rarity) gate what is decomposable and the yield tier
functions.notes: DECOMPOSE_ITEM_VO_CLASSNANE is the game's misspelling of CLASSNAME. _DAT_00000000 vtbl deref is a decompiler artifact (null-based struct field), not a real null-call.
